question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.
sql:
WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        l.name AS league,
        c.name AS country,
        ht.team_long_name AS team_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team ht ON m.home_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        l.name AS league,
        c.name AS country,
        awt.team_long_name AS team_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team awt ON m.away_team_api_id = awt.team_api_id
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league,
        country,
        team_name,
        SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league, country, team_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league,
        country,
        team_name,
        CAST(total_points AS INTEGER) AS total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rn
    FROM team_points
)
SELECT season, league, country, team_name, total_points
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season, league
